name: Sofia Alvarez
role: Final-year student in public health, writes her thesis notes in a mix of paper and phone apps.
context: She followed a link a friend shared in a study group. She has never heard of the product, does not know the word 'knowledge management' and has no budget beyond free.
daily_tasks: Reads papers, takes notes, shares them with two classmates, schedules her week. Uses what is free and obvious.
fears: Looking stupid; installing something she cannot understand; a free trial that charges her card later.
never_reads: Anything with words she has to look up. She stops at the first sentence she cannot paraphrase.
decides_by: The first ten seconds. If the headline says what it is in plain words she scrolls; if not, she goes back to the chat and says 'no idea'. She picks what her friends already use.
stake_rules: Primary on a home page that could become her tool. Secondary on a pricing page, only to see if it is free. Bystander on an enterprise or admin page.
